tasks.short: Maintain attendance and required student results

steps.what: Capture actual forestry course attendance and check supporting assessment records
Enter required course results in the learning system
Check exact results, student identifiers and registry destinations for transfer
Re-key the approved results into the separate student registry
Check registry receipt and resolve rejected entries

tasks.design: Test the native {LMS} results export and student-registry import before building a connector. Transfer only the checked snapshot to the separate registry in {OTHER}, rejecting missing student, course or assessment mappings and retaining capture, grading and receipt checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same results are entered into two distinct systems.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed field mapping can remove the second entry without inferring grades.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving exceptions and determining the correct student result.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm attendance, assessment evidence and final student outcomes.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time duplicating results while retaining responsibility for every result.

evidence.claim: The supplied digest describes required double publication of learning-system grades in a separate student registry; Radboud's Brightspace and OSIRIS are its example.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe the explicit two-system results workflow, not a measured institution. OTHER is the student registry. A single-system institution has no second-entry benefit.

Teacher-produced inputs include student ID, course and assessment ID, attempt, result, result status and effective date. Capture and initial entry remain s1-s2; there is no assumed free attendance sensor or unreviewed grade producer.

The registry owner supplies permitted mappings. Missing mappings stop for manual correction in s3/s5; more than the retained receipt allowance requires a lower estimate. Native import is tested first.
s3 authorizes the exact second-system transfer after the final results exist. Edits invalidate approval. Initial same-system entry and ordinary saves stay fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Actual registry import support and double-entry share
research_questions: Observe one results cycle and test native export/import with retakes and duplicate identifiers.

incremental.description: Maintain assessment mappings and investigate new transfer failures

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact results snapshot, identifiers and registry destinations; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 30 second-entry points less 1.2 upkeep. With legacy field-course grading scales, retain manual entry for those results and transfer only 6 points of ordinary mapped results: 6 minus 1.2 = 4.8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current with forestry and conservation developments

steps.what: Find relevant new forestry and conservation publications
Read current literature and evaluate methods and findings
Discuss developments with forestry and conservation colleagues
Participate in professional conferences and assess their research

tasks.design: Configure saved topic queries in the publication catalogue in {OTHER} for established forestry and conservation subjects. This removes repeated query entry only; the teacher still selects and reads sources, talks with colleagues and attends conferences.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeating established catalogue queries adds navigation without improving critical reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches can reuse exact topic and date criteria.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing relevance, method quality and implications for local ecosystems.
tasks.human_edge: Connect evidence with field experience and teaching needs.
tasks.altitude: No change to scholarly judgement or professional participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: publication catalogues commonly support saved searches, which can reuse query criteria but do not replace scholarly reading.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a cycle with repeated topic searches. OTHER is a scholarly publication catalogue, not an invented research summary service.

The teacher supplies topic terms, date window and subject filters; publication metadata comes from the existing catalogue. Native saved-search configuration is assessed first. Missing metadata requires ordinary manual search within s1.
Only 3 of 15 discovery points are repeated query entry; the other 12 remain source selection, new searches and access problems. Existing automated notifications are runtime, not a saving baseline.
The task does not establish an obligatory reading log or conference report. None is added. Actual bibliographies, travel arrangements or reports would need their own observed boundaries.
unknowns: Existing saved searches and actual repeated-query effort
research_questions: Time repeated query entry separately from reading and selection before configuring searches.

incremental.description: Revise saved topics when the field or teaching scope changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 3 repeated query-entry points, less 0.5 upkeep. When emerging conservation topics need fresh terms, reuse only 1 point of stable forestry queries and retain the other discovery work: 1 minus 0.5 = 0.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise teaching, internship and research work

steps.what: Read actual student teaching, internship and research work
Observe and supervise actual teaching, internship and research activity
Discuss development needs, methods and safe field practice with students

tasks.design: Retain direct supervision and separate work reading in {DOCS} and {LMS}. Test the existing native student-work view first; this scenario already provides direct access, and neither a template nor a model removes the contextual review or live guidance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on the actual student's work and field practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared work provides access, but no additional labour-removing change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe practice and giving developmentally appropriate guidance.
tasks.human_edge: Judge competence and adapt supervision to the student and field setting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct teaching, internship and research supervision requires reviewing actual work and providing contextual guidance.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover a supervision encounter, not formal grading or a required internship evaluation. Students supply their actual work; the teacher's reading is fully counted.

Before zero, inspect lookup, preparation, written assessment and send boundaries. This scenario has direct work access and establishes no required supervisor-owned written output; it does not add a progress log. If an actual evaluation or feedback document is required, add and assess it before using zero for that workflow.
Native views already provide work access. No repetitive navigation saving, new capture or shifted clerical work is assumed. No automation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written evaluation duties within supervision
research_questions: Observe supervision and identify any existing required written feedback, lookup or submission.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 25 reading, 50 observation and 25 discussion points. New field methods still require personal review and guidance; no established duplicate record or preparation operation has been identified to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Read the existing teaching plan, research issue and colleague contributions
Resolve teaching and research issues through discussion with colleagues
Revise the existing teaching or research plan and check its meaning

loop.purpose: Draft only the teacher-specified revision to an existing plan
loop.input: Existing plan and teacher-authored agreed changes
loop.output: Proposed plan revision with change references
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, omissions, responsibilities and research claims against agreed changes and reads the complete revision
loop.stop: Missing agreement, unsupported claim or two failed revisions returns the edit to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tracked changes and fixed headings come first; variable agreed prose needs a bounded draft, not decision automation

tasks.design: Use native tracked changes in {DOCS} first for an existing plan the teacher already maintains with colleagues. A bounded draft can restate specified agreed changes; the teacher still resolves the issue, checks the full revision and saves it normally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed changes must be restated coherently in an existing shared plan.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can apply a limited set of specified prose changes with source references.
tasks.still_hard: Reaching agreement on teaching priorities and defensible research methods.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate trade-offs and own the revised scientific or teaching content.
tasks.altitude: Less restatement work, with the same collaborative decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded document drafting can restate supplied changes, but collaborators must verify scientific meaning and responsibilities.

assumptions: Provisional scenario is collaboration that already revises an existing shared teaching or research plan used by colleagues. Conversation-only collaboration has no new required record and must be reweighted without this benefit.

The teacher supplies the current plan, exact agreed changes, section references and unresolved issues in the normal edit process. s3 retains that input, substantive editing, source checks, failed-draft repair and ordinary save. No meeting transcript or new capture duty is assumed.

Only 2 of the 20 revision points are prose restatement removed; 18 remain. Native editing is tested first. A same-system author save is fully retained and ungated. No separate message or formal release is assumed.
unknowns: Existing plan ownership and actual restatement effort
research_questions: Compare one real agreed revision using native editing and a bounded draft, counting corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain draft instructions and review recurring omission patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2 restatement points less 0.6 upkeep. For a novel research-method dispute, retain substantive rewriting and remove only 0.8 of routine wording changes: 0.8 minus 0.6 = 0.2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain forestry teaching, scholarly judgement and supervision; reduce verified duplicate entry and limited document restatement.
role.ambitious_version: No broader service is justified by these provisional task estimates.
